page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. No margin notes. Running head at top centre, page number at top left. A catchword at the lower right.

main_text.p: irreptionis accusare, Si hic est accusa-tionis sensus, omnes accusandi sunt Catholici tractatores; vix enim aliquis est, qui in hunc occasione data non impege-rit, imò contrarium omnes asseruerunt & occasione data fecerunt. Cardinalis Bel-larminus l. 2. de verbo Dei c. ii. quatuor occasiones refert, in quibus ad fontes confugere licet. 1. Quando in nostris codicibus videtur esse error librariorum. 2. Quando Latini codices variant. 5. Quando verba aut sententia in Latino est anceps. 4. Ad energiam & proprietatem vocabulorum intelligendam. Pau-lo ante de approbatione Concilii ita edi-xerat, nec ita tamen approbavit, ut asseru-erit nullos in ea librariorum errores reperiri, sed certos nos reddere voluit in iis praeser-tim, quae ad fidem & mores pertinent, nulla esse in hac versione interpretum errata. Idem Cardinalis litteris scriptis ad Lu-cam Brugensem Anno 1603. page.notes: Printing error: the list numbering runs 1, 2, 5, 4; the third item is printed as "5." (presumably 3). Left as printed. Some words are set in italic only partly; the italic spans follow the visible type. The "ii" in "c. ii." is printed in small Roman form. The catchword "gere" is taken from the bottom right and kept out of the text. Scan is faint in places, so the readings "impege-rit", "praeser-tim" and "asseru-erit" rest on the visible hyphens.
